description: End-to-end QA/QC smoke test for Fleet Commander using Kimi WebBridge to drive the user's real browser and validate every route, button, form, and user-facing interaction from a user perspective.
deviation_notes: Deep workflow testing revealed 7 findings (2 Critical, 3 High, 2 Medium). Multiple routes redirect to wrong destinations. Agent creation works but has validation gaps.

sprint.goal: Run a 100% route-coverage smoke test that touches every user-facing element on every page, validates the click/hover/fill/submit path, captures a screenshot per route, and files one tech-debt row per finding.
sprint.demo_notes: Demonstrate the QA dashboard: total routes covered, total elements exercised, pass/fail breakdown, screenshots archive, TD entries filed.
